headlines.title: ECB bond buying: what the economists say
Eurozone crisis: ECB introduces unlimited bond-buying programme
ECB introduces unlimited bond-buying in boldest attempt yet to end euro crisis
Huge Step Taken by Europe’s Bank to Abate a Crisis
headlines.abstract: The European Central Bank took its broadest step yet toward easing the euro zone crisis, throwing its financial clout behind an effort to fend off financial collapse for Spain and Italy.

headlines.abstract: Encouraging unemployment data helped bolster optimism that the rally might last.
